feature: Customer Portal v2 Part 5 -- Operate -> Remediation Tracker (/portal-v2/remediation). Recreated from the prototype's own `isRemediation` block ('Customer Portal Shell.dc.html' 5961-6012) and its `rtRun` derivation (20380-20441), transcribed into remediationModel.ts and pinned by unit assertions. Not a project plan and not a quote -- a run-down of what has been fixed and what has not, off the design's own RT_PHASES fixture (30 tasks across three phases). A progress bar, four state counters that double as filters (Fixed and verified / Done, awaiting re-scan / Still to do / Accepted as-is), and every finding grouped under its pillar with the state it is in, who closes it, a change-request badge on Shane-run done items, and the pillar's responsible RACI owner.
notes: THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL. /portal-v2/* sits behind ProtectedRoute; a probe that skips the five login steps hits the login screen and every assertion fails for a reason unrelated to the page.

UI ROUTE SHAPE: msp-portal's outer WouterRouter has base '/portal' and SlugScope nests a second router at '/{slug}', so the real URL is /portal/{slug}/portal-v2/remediation. App.tsx declares it BEFORE '/portal-v2/:pillar' so the param route cannot swallow it -- Remediation is a plain, param-free route.
shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree; this manifest needs the Part 5 pages deployed first.

PERSISTED-SESSION FLAKE (known): when WebView2 is already authed, the two input steps against #email/#password can fail while the rest runs green because auth persists. N-2 of N with only those two red is a PASS for the feature.

STATUS vs VERIFICATION -- THE LOAD-BEARING ASSERTION. RT6 asserts the 'Fixed and verified' counter reads 0. No fixture task carries `verified`; only a real scan's reverifyRemediationTrackerSteps() (#732, server-side) may set it, and this page never derives verified from UI state. Every done task instead reads 'Awaiting re-scan' (RT13). If a future edit ever promoted a step to verified off tick/filter state, RT6 goes red.

COMPUTED NUMBERS: the headline '3 of 30 things fixed since the first scan.' (RT1), '10%' / '3 / 30' (RT3-RT4) and the counter values (RT6-RT9) are all summed from RT_PHASES, not typed -- three tasks are done (p1a, p1g, p1h, all Shane-run), the other 27 open, none verified, none accepted.
ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.
